def sha(path):
    path=Path(path)
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b""): h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
def pin(path, expected):
    path=Path(path)
    key=str(path.resolve())
    actual=checked.get(key)
    if actual is None:
        actual=sha(path);checked[key]=actual
    assert actual==expected,("HASH_MISMATCH",key,expected,actual)
    return path
